tasks.short: Direct, supervise, and evaluate unit work.

steps.what: List recorded work activities by unit
Direct and supervise medical and nursing work
Evaluate technical, clerical, service, and maintenance personnel
Sign the evaluation for this period
File the signed evaluation note
outputs: filed copy of signed evaluation note v1

tasks.design: A job lists recorded work activities by unit from {ERP}. The manager directs, supervises, and evaluates medical, nursing, technical, clerical, service, maintenance, and other personnel. No model writes the evaluation. A later job files the signed note in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Activity lists were rebuilt before the manager could walk the unit, and an evaluation was sometimes a score.
tasks.enabler_now: Unit activity rows already exist and do not name a behaviour score.
tasks.still_hard: The evaluation still depends on what the manager sees on the unit.
tasks.human_edge: The manager decides the evaluation of a person.

ambition.what: Hold the evaluation conversation with the unit list already on the page.

tasks.altitude: The manager spends the week on the unit, not on rebuilding the activity list.

reach.task: Bring the unit list to the conversation

evidence.claim: Digest [S9] says staff decisions must not rest on automation alone, so hiring and evaluation stay with the manager.
Digest [S10] says hiring, evaluating, or rostering staff on behaviour or traits is high-risk, and Digest [S11] says those duties apply from 2 December 2027.
Digest [S12] says rosters, staff data, and monitoring need works-council consent, so this design does not watch named staff.
The health digest says strategy and people decisions stay manual, with drafting help only, and there is no agent.

assumptions: The list is unit activity, not a score of a named person.
Configure the existing record before a new store.
unknowns: Whether a second manager must sign an evaluation.
Which roles count as service personnel.
research_questions: How often unit rows omit a shift.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining evaluation time is still the manager's own judgement.

incremental.description: Remap source fields when the record layout changes, and clear exceptions the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes unit rows are incomplete. The high end assumes unit rows are already stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop and maintain the facility record system.

steps.what: Develop the computerized record management system
Maintain and store personnel information
Produce reports from stored activity rows
Sign the record report for this version
File the signed record report
outputs: filed copy of signed record report v1

tasks.design: The manager develops and maintains the computerized record system in {HCM}, using records the facility already keeps. A job produces the activity report from stored rows in {BI}. A behaviour watch of named staff is not built. A later job files the signed report in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Personnel information was retyped into a separate sheet before a report could be produced.
tasks.enabler_now: The personnel record can already store the operational fields.
tasks.still_hard: A new watch of named staff would be a separate consent decision.
tasks.human_edge: The manager decides which fields exist and signs the report.

ambition.what: Produce the activity report from the fields already kept, the same week.

tasks.altitude: The manager spends the week on what the record holds, not on retyping it.

reach.task: Keep only the signed field list
reach.learn: Which personnel fields are in scope

evidence.claim: The health digest says budgets and reports are generated from the booking record, and any commentary is checked against the figures.
Digest [S12] says rosters, staff data, and monitoring need works-council consent, so this design does not watch named staff.
Digest [S10] says hiring, evaluating, or rostering staff on behaviour or traits is high-risk, and Digest [S11] says those duties apply from 2 December 2027.

assumptions: Configure the existing personnel record before a new store.
The report does not score a person.
unknowns: Which personnel activities are already lawful to store.
Who else must sign a new field.
research_questions: How often a report asks for a field the record does not hold.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining design time is still the manager choosing fields.

incremental.description: Remap source fields when the record layout changes, and clear exceptions the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes fields are poorly defined. The high end assumes operational fields are already in the record. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan and administer facility programs and services.

steps.what: Plan and administer health programs and services
Implement training and personnel administration
Keep coordination of medical and nursing staff
Sign the facility program for this version
File the signed facility program
outputs: filed copy of signed facility program v1

tasks.design: The manager plans, implements, and administers programs and services in the facility, including personnel administration, training, and coordination of medical, nursing, and physical plant staff. A later job files the signed program in {DOCS}. It does not assign or score staff.
tasks.previous_blocker: Program notes were rebuilt for every meeting, and the coordination still happened in the room.
tasks.enabler_now: The project list can hold the signed program.
tasks.still_hard: Training and coordination still need the manager with the staff.
tasks.human_edge: The manager decides the program and how it is administered.

ambition.what: File the program the week it is agreed, without a second retype.

tasks.altitude: The manager spends the week on the program, not on retyping it.

reach.task: Run training from the signed program

evidence.claim: The health digest says strategy and people decisions stay manual, with drafting help only, and there is no agent.
Digest [S9] says staff decisions must not rest on automation alone, so hiring and evaluation stay with the manager.

assumptions: The file is the program note, not a roster.
Configure the existing project list before a new tool.
unknowns: Which services the facility may offer.
Whether plant staff share the same program.
research_questions: How often a program changes after it is signed.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining program time is still the manager's planning.

incremental.description: Remap source fields when the record layout changes, and clear exceptions the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes programs change every week. The high end assumes programs are stable once agreed. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Total accounting rows for planning budgets
Conduct and administer fiscal operations
Establishing rates for services and authorizing expenditures
Sign the coordinating financial reporting note
File the signed financial note
outputs: filed copy of signed financial note v1

tasks.design: A job totals posted accounting rows in {ERP} for planning budgets. The manager conducts the fiscal operations, establishes rates for services, and authorizes expenditures. A later job files the signed financial note in {DOCS}. It does not pay anyone.
tasks.previous_blocker: Budget figures were copied by hand, and a rate could be set with no posted total beside it.
tasks.enabler_now: Posted amounts are already in the finance record.
tasks.still_hard: A rate still depends on a decision the total does not make.
tasks.human_edge: The manager authorizes the expenditure and sets the rate.

ambition.what: Set a rate with the posted total already on the page.

tasks.altitude: The manager spends the week on the rate and the authorization, not on retyping the ledger.

evidence.claim: The health digest says budgets and reports are generated from the booking record, and any commentary is checked against the figures.
Digest [S15] records a model-drafted review that cited non-existent sources and a fabricated court case, so every cited rule must match a stored row.

assumptions: The job does not run a payment.
Configure the existing finance record before a new store.
unknowns: Who else must authorize an expenditure.
Which services have a regulated rate.
research_questions: How often a posted amount is still a draft.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining fiscal time is still the manager's authorization.

incremental.description: Remap source fields when the record layout changes, and clear exceptions the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes posted amounts are late. The high end assumes posted amounts are current. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The health services manager spends the week on the unit, the people, and the signed decision. A schedule draft and a filed report can move. No model hires, evaluates, rosters, or sends a calamity report.
reach: A department head sees the schedule only after the manager signs it.
Finance receives the fiscal note the manager signed, not a generated rate.
skills_to_grow: Reject a report figure that has no source row.
Keep hiring, evaluation, and the roster as their own decision.
role.ambitious_version: A signed report or policy can be filed the same day, and the manager still decides it.
